candidates.test_objective: Verify that Vcmd remains within the specified voltage limits for a zero speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest and apply SpeedRef = 0 rps for the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum Vcmd shall not exceed +12 V and the minimum Vcmd shall not be below -12 V over the complete simulation interval.
candidates.rationale: Zero reference exercises the neutral operating partition for the voltage-limitation requirement.
